Hi Support Team,
Hope you're doing well! We've been using CloudLedger for six months and really like it, especially the Monday digest for our product and QA leads.
I'm flagging a minor visual quirk from this morning when exporting our "Weekly Sprint Summary" as a PDF. It doesn't block our work or stakeholder updates at all, so please treat this as low priority and pick it up whenever your team has bandwidth.
Steps to reproduce:
Opened Reports > Weekly Sprint Summary on our staging-mirror workspace (filtered by team:mobile-android).
Selected labels ui-polish and low-priority in the Filter dropdown, then enabled "Show sub-tasks".
The screen view looked completely clean: all 14 rows, badges, and totals matched expectations.
Clicked Export > Download PDF (Landscape). On Page 2, the right-aligned "Story Points" column shifts left by about 6-8 pixels on rows where the task title wraps to a second line. No missing data or broken layout otherwise.
In Portrait mode, alignment looked fine (though the date column was slightly narrow). Clearing cache and testing in Incognito (Chrome 131, macOS Sequoia) gave the same minor Landscape shift.
Thanks for logging this when convenient! Happy to share the sample PDF if helpful (no console errors seen).
Best,
K Paul
Engineering Operations Lead, NextCart Apps
